note: Committed baseline for the deterministic CI eval gate (Req 13). checkRegression fails the run on a pass-rate drop, a PER-CATEGORY pass-rate drop, a category vanishing from the run, or >20% growth in median steps/tokens. The suite is deterministic — the model is scripted — so a difference here is a real difference and not run-to-run noise, which on model-in-the-loop benchmarks is 2-6 points even at temperature 0. `v1` is the legacy-engine reference for the release record.
